ecosystem.quoteIntro: One of the Dominican fathers said:
ecosystem.quoteText: "The Bible must be comfortable for you. Comfortable in your hand, but also comfortable to understand."
ecosystem.quoteExplanation: That's why instead of an old app that hadn't been developed for months, I created Biblia AI. You can customize it to your needs, and the built-in spiritual companion will answer any question you have...
ecosystem.intro: Thank you for downloading our app! We build minimalistic, ultra-fast, local-first tools without unnecessary spam. Check out what else we have created for you:
ecosystem.bibliaDesc: Your personal spiritual companion and mobile center for studying the Holy Scripture. Theological analysis, original languages, and offline reading plans.
ecosystem.kaucjaDesc: Earn on ecology. Find the nearest bottle machine, check occupancy status, collect points, and redeem coupons.
ecosystem.prawoJazdyDesc: Revolutionary theory learning. Play 'Tinder of road signs', solve smart tests, and pass the state exam.
ecosystem.smartNajemDesc: Professional property management. Generate secure agreements, settle utilities, and track payments on your phone.
